title: First time using Opus 5.5. Made a roguelite Plinko battle royale you can play in your browser
author: MightyBig-Dev
selftext:
I usually build with Codex using Sol or Astra, but gave Opus 5.5 a go with **Drop Dead**, a little roguelite Plinko battle royale idea I’ve been kicking around.  Damn it really followed instructions well. I’m impressed. And I’m a big time hater lmao. 

Pick upgrades, place them on your board, then drop your pucks and hope your build pays off. Upgrades stick around between rounds, and the lowest score gets knocked out until one player remains. The opponents are bots for now but your real scores will save and once a few dozen people have played the bots will be out and real async players replace them.

I went for an old-school handheld LCD look and designed it for phones first. The idea was something anyone could pick up, with enough choices to make you want another run.

It’s a playable prototype, does it make sense without an explanation, and is it fun enough to play again?

You can play it at the link no download needed.

comments.author: Best_Professor_9966
comments.body: pretty fun once you stack the upgrades, cohesive design, nice job!

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Thanks homie 🫡 whipped it up in just 1 night. Just having some fun 😇. I love designing new toys lmao

comments.author: klas-klattermus
comments.body: Kinda fun but braindead, just funnel everything to the middle and stack multipliers

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Lmao I agree it’s super easy. First iteration woes. Thanks for checking it out tho, 5 minutes in this economy is awesome. 😎

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
I'm sure there are some "arcade hall" sites out there for AI apps where you could submit it too.
In general I think there's a big potential for something like those old flash games sites but for AI games

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Yea I've seen tons of people posting game library sites they're building. Tbh I don't really care much. I like to just share my creations and chat with other ai game devs. That's my idea of a good time 😆

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
I'm with you!
I'm probably behind the Times but what do you think about the game model of players renting servers for their games? It's more common than ever, especially with Roblox. Personally I'm paying like 6€ a month for an enshrouded server that me and a friend plays on for like 10 hours a month and I'm ok with that.
Smaller games with like a 3€ a month server cost or free to play single player could definitely be a good thing for browser games. Anything to keep p2w or in-game gambling and ads away.

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: I think it’s great. Especially when you give the users ability to mod their servers. That how games get longevity. Plenty of games out there would be dead by now without custom servers.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
Yeah, and I like games that are more like "experience things together" rather than "grinding competitively", which is better suited to games with a smaller player base.
I'm really curious to see if we can make games great again thanks to AI

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: We absolutely can. The stuff I make is small time but there are teams of people cooking as we speak

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body: Yeah I've seen a lot of cool things, any groups, games or sites you want to share that you think looks cool?

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: I got nothin. I’m just a hobbiest myself. But I peruse the ai subs for cool games in development and there are a lot, some of them are super high quality.

replies.author: klas-klattermus
replies.body:
Yeah same here, got a family and a full time job as a developer so I just make apps and games for fun.
Well, good luck and see you around out there!

comments.author: jedruch
comments.body:
Hey, this is really cool, spent 20+ minutes.
Can you describe how did you feed the model with your idea? Did you use any particular skills or tools?

The reason I'm asking is that it seems polished and coherent and I struggle a lot to get to this point in my projects

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body:
Thanks for checking it out!  I’ve been kicking this idea around for a while like 6 months. I had the idea for plinko rogue like battle royale but never had a good vibe for it, like the theming and stuff. Then I was goofing around the other night and made this stupid wario ware type [game](https://gameboi.mightybig.ca/). So a couple weeks later I decided that style would be a good fit for dropped. 

I had a design doc I’d been working on for months. Add to it randomly when an idea struck. 

Gave the design doc to opus with all the look, feel, gameplay, multiplayer, etc and let it run. This thing was coded and deployed with multiplayer in about 3 hours. 

It’s not perfect but it’s neat. I only post here to see if maybe I’ve got lightning in a bottle and should continue developing. Based on the response probably not. Few people seemed to like it but not viral levels of enjoyment.  

Either way I just make stuff for fun, the love of the games… but yea if something is hot I keep refining it.
